name: Goat Milk
siboNotes: Contains less lactose than cow's milk but still problematic in larger amounts for SIBO patients. Start with very small portions to test tolerance.
preparationTips: Use in small amounts as a coffee creamer or in smoothies
Consider lactase enzyme supplements if consuming larger portions
Can be heated or used in cooking without affecting FODMAP content
Mix with lactose-free milk to extend volume while reducing lactose
nutritionalHighlights: Easier to digest than cow's milk for some people
